3	description: "How kitchen/bar + receipt printing actually works on Android/print-agent, and the SOP for finding/setting a new client's printer IP"
4	metadata: 
5	  node_type: memory
6	  type: project

8	  modified: 2026-07-27T14:42:24.587Z
9	---
10	
11	Printing architecture (built 2026-07-26/27, verified against real hardware — an Epson TM-T82II-i on LAN and an RPP02N on Bluetooth):
12	
13	- Server only builds ESC/POS ticket bytes (`buildKitchenTicket` / `buildReceiptTicket` in `src/lib/escpos.ts`) — it can never reach a printer's private LAN IP or Bluetooth. The **client** (Android app's native `KitchenPrinterPlugin.kt`, or `print-agent/` on PC) sends the bytes. See `src/lib/dispatch-print-jobs.ts`.
14	- `kitchen_printers.prints_receipt` (bool) marks a printer as the **cashier's receipt printer**: it auto-gets the priced customer receipt at checkout (bypasses `window.print()`, which doesn't work for cheap Bluetooth ESC/POS printers — Android's OS print framework generally can't drive them) and is *excluded* from the automatic kitchen-ticket fan-out even if its categories match everything. Toggle lives in Settings next to each printer.
15	- Receipt jobs dispatch and complete before kitchen jobs (`dispatchReceiptThenKitchenJobs`) since one physical printer often does both roles and Bluetooth sockets don't like concurrent writes.
16	- Known fixed bug: `KitchenPrinterPlugin.kt`'s Bluetooth path used to call `adapter.cancelDiscovery()`, which throws without `BLUETOOTH_SCAN` permission (deliberately never requested — app only reads paired devices). Removed; don't re-add it.
17	
18	**SOP for a new client's LAN printer IP** — full illustrated version published as an Artifact: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/c9c32eab-6ff7-46c9-814c-ba04fa081edd (source file was in this session's scratchpad, so re-publish from that URL if it needs updating from a future session — pass it as `url` to Artifact).
19	
20	Condensed steps:
21	1. Printer reset button (usually rear, pen-tip), hold **3–4 sec** → prints a network settings report (IP, DHCP status, MAC). **Never >10 sec** (factory reset).
22	2. Check the `DHCP` line: **Enable** → find the IP via the client's router admin page (connected devices / DHCP client list, match by MAC). **Disable** → printer sits at its factory-default IP (Epson default: `192.168.192.168`), a different subnet than the client's WiFi — go to step 3.
23	3. If `ARP+Ping: Enable` on the report (near-universal on Epson), set a new static IP with zero risk to the PC's own network config:
24	   ```
25	   netsh interface ipv4 add neighbors "<WiFi adapter name>" <chosen free IP> <printer MAC, hyphens>
26	   ping <chosen IP> -n 4
27	   ```
28	   First ping often times out (printer still switching) — retry. Confirm the chosen IP is free first with a plain `ping` (unreachable/timeout = free).
29	4. Enter the new IP in Kasirku → Pengaturan → Printer Dapur & Bar, then Tes Cetak to confirm.
30	
31	**Why:** direct `Test-NetConnection`/browser access to the Epson's WebConfig (`/PrinterConfigurationPage/`) failed on every common port (80/443/8080/8000) even though ICMP ping worked — EpsonNet Config also isn't offered for `-i` (Intelligent) model variants on Epson's download center. ARP+Ping turned out to be the only reliable no-software path for this printer class.
32	
33	**How to apply:** don't suggest `New-NetIPAddress` / changing the PC's own WiFi adapter IP to reach a mismatched-subnet printer — it broke the user's WiFi entirely on the first attempt (2026-07-27) and required a phone/Gemini fallback to recover. `netsh ... add neighbors` + `route add` (a narrow host route, if ever needed again for reaching a printer's *original* default IP e.g. to read its WebConfig) don't touch the adapter's own IP/gateway/DNS and are the safe alternative.
34

---
name: kitchen-printer-lan-bluetooth
description: "How kitchen/bar + receipt printing actually works on Android/print-agent, and the SOP for finding/setting a new client's printer IP"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 813a231d-ee20-4309-a3d8-302f9ddd53fe

---

Printing architecture (built 2026-07-26/27, verified against real hardware — an Epson TM-T82II-i on LAN and an RPP02N on Bluetooth):

- Server only builds ESC/POS ticket bytes (`buildKitchenTicket` / `buildReceiptTicket` in `src/lib/escpos.ts`) — it can never reach a printer's private LAN IP or Bluetooth. The **client** (Android app's native `KitchenPrinterPlugin.kt`, or `print-agent/` on PC) sends the bytes. See `src/lib/dispatch-print-jobs.ts`.
- `kitchen_printers.prints_receipt` (bool) marks a printer as the **cashier's receipt printer**: it auto-gets the priced customer receipt at checkout (bypasses `window.print()`, which doesn't work for cheap Bluetooth ESC/POS printers — Android's OS print framework generally can't drive them) and is *excluded* from the automatic kitchen-ticket fan-out even if its categories match everything. Toggle lives in Settings next to each printer.
- Receipt jobs dispatch and complete before kitchen jobs (`dispatchReceiptThenKitchenJobs`) since one physical printer often does both roles and Bluetooth sockets don't like concurrent writes.
- Known fixed bug: `KitchenPrinterPlugin.kt`'s Bluetooth path used to call `adapter.cancelDiscovery()`, which throws without `BLUETOOTH_SCAN` permission (deliberately never requested — app only reads paired devices). Removed; don't re-add it.

**SOP for a new client's LAN printer IP** — full illustrated version published as an Artifact: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/c9c32eab-6ff7-46c9-814c-ba04fa081edd (source file was in this session's scratchpad, so re-publish from that URL if it needs updating from a future session — pass it as `url` to Artifact).

Condensed steps:
1. Printer reset button (usually rear, pen-tip), hold **3–4 sec** → prints a network settings report (IP, DHCP status, MAC). **Never >10 sec** (factory reset).
2. Check the `DHCP` line: **Enable** → find the IP via the client's router admin page (connected devices / DHCP client list, match by MAC). **Disable** → printer sits at its factory-default IP (Epson default: `192.168.192.168`), a different subnet than the client's WiFi — go to step 3.
3. If `ARP+Ping: Enable` on the report (near-universal on Epson), set a new static IP with zero risk to the PC's own network config:
   ```
   netsh interface ipv4 add neighbors "<WiFi adapter name>" <chosen free IP> <printer MAC, hyphens>
   ping <chosen IP> -n 4
   ```
   First ping often times out (printer still switching) — retry. Confirm the chosen IP is free first with a plain `ping` (unreachable/timeout = free).
4. Enter the new IP in Kasirku → Pengaturan → Printer Dapur & Bar, then Tes Cetak to confirm.

**Why:** direct `Test-NetConnection`/browser access to the Epson's WebConfig (`/PrinterConfigurationPage/`) failed on every common port (80/443/8080/8000) even though ICMP ping worked — EpsonNet Config also isn't offered for `-i` (Intelligent) model variants on Epson's download center. ARP+Ping turned out to be the only reliable no-software path for this printer class.

**How to apply:** don't suggest `New-NetIPAddress` / changing the PC's own WiFi adapter IP to reach a mismatched-subnet printer — it broke the user's WiFi entirely on the first attempt (2026-07-27) and required a phone/Gemini fallback to recover. `netsh ... add neighbors` + `route add` (a narrow host route, if ever needed again for reaching a printer's *original* default IP e.g. to read its WebConfig) don't touch the adapter's own IP/gateway/DNS and are the safe alternative.

---

## Fitur 1 — Diskon Settings

### POS Screen (Diskon Manual)

**File:** `G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu\src\app\business\[businessId]\pos\pos-screen.tsx`

**CartItem type** (baris 49–57):
```ts
type CartItem = {
  productId: string;

  price: number;
  qty: number;
  maxStock: number;
  disc: number;
  discType: DiscountType;  // "pct" | "amt"

```

**Lokasi komponen input diskon manual:**

- **Diskon per item** — baris 1197–1256: tombol `"% Diskon"` per item di keranjang. Klik toggle `editingDiscId`. Saat terbuka muncul toggle `% / Rp` (button set `discType`) + `<input type="number">` yang memanggil `setItemDisc(productId, value, discType)`. Tampil di dalam loop `cart.map()` di sidebar keranjang kanan.

- **Diskon order (order-level)** — baris 1344–1406: tombol `"% Diskon Order"` di bagian bawah sidebar keranjang (area summary/total). Klik toggle `orderDiscOpen`. Saat terbuka muncul toggle `% / Rp` + `<input type="number">` yang mengubah `orderDisc` dan `orderDiscType`.

**State yang terlibat:**
- `editingDiscId` (string|null) — id produk yang sedang diedit diskonnya
- `orderDisc` (number, default 0) + `orderDiscType` ("pct"|"amt", default "pct")
- Fungsi: `setItemDisc(productId, disc, discType)` di baris 362

**DiscountType** didefinisikan di dua tempat yang identik:
- `src\app\business\[businessId]\pos\actions.ts` baris 55: `export type DiscountType = "pct" | "amt";`
- `src\lib\checkout-totals.ts` baris 1: `export type DiscountType = "pct" | "amt";`

-- Aturan diskon yang bisa dikonfigurasi pemilik di Pengaturan.
-- Dua tipe:
--   per_product : diskon otomatis saat produk tertentu masuk keranjang.
--   promo       : diskon seluruh order (berlaku berdasarkan tanggal &
--                 toggle aktif/nonaktif). Hanya satu promo aktif yang
--                 diterapkan kasir pada satu waktu.
-- Kasir tidak bisa lagi mengisi diskon manual — nilai diskon di-preset
-- di sini dan diterapkan otomatis oleh POS.

create table public.discount_rules (
  id          uuid    primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid    not null references public.businesses(id) on delete cascade,
  type        text    not null check (type in ('per_product', 'promo')),
  product_id  uuid    references public.products(id) on delete cascade,
  name        text,
  value       numeric(10,2) not null default 0,
  value_type  text    not null default 'pct' check (value_type in ('pct', 'amt')),
  active      boolean not null default true,
  valid_from  date,
  valid_until date,
  created_at  timestamptz default now(),
  constraint per_product_needs_product check (type = 'promo' or product_id is not null),
  constraint valid_discount_value      check (value >= 0 and (value_type = 'amt' or value <= 100))
);

create index discount_rules_business_id_idx on public.discount_rules(business_id);

alter table public.discount_rules enable row level security;

create policy "owners_discount_rules"
  on public.discount_rules
  for all
  using (private.owns_business(business_id));

Berikut laporan audit teknis lengkap berdasarkan pembacaan mendalam seluruh file yang diminta.

---

# AUDIT TEKNIS KASIRKU — 2026-08-02

---

## 1. KRITIS — Blokir Go-Live

### K1. UTC Date Bug di `activePromo` — `pos-screen.tsx:234`

```typescript
// SALAH — ini tanggal UTC, bukan WIB
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
```

Codebase sendiri mendokumentasikan bahwa pattern ini **salah untuk konteks Indonesia** — lihat `src/lib/wib.ts` baris 3–8:

> "JANGAN pakai `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` untuk 'hari ini' — itu tanggal UTC, yang antara jam 00:00–07:00 WIB masih menunjuk ke *kemarin*."

**Dampak konkret:**
- Promo yang `valid_from` = "hari ini" tidak akan aktif sampai pukul 07:00 WIB.
- Promo yang `valid_until` = "kemarin" akan tetap aktif sampai pukul 07:00 WIB (diskon salah diterapkan).
- Fitur ini baru diimplementasi 2026-08-02, jadi tidak ada kesempatan produksi sebelumnya untuk mendeteksi bug ini.

**Fix**: Ganti dengan `todayWibDateString()` dari `src/lib/wib.ts`.

---

### K2. UTC Date Bug Meluas — `ticket-actions.ts:105` dan `member-panel.tsx:168`

Bug yang sama ditemukan di dua tempat lain:

`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/ticket-actions.ts:105`:
```typescript
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
if (today < data.valid_from || today > data.valid_until) {
  return { success: false, error: "Membership tidak aktif..." };
}
```

`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/member-panel.tsx:168`:
```typescript
const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const active = m.validUntil >= today;
```

**Dampak konkret (bisnis tiket):**
- Anggota yang kartu membershipnya berlaku "mulai hari ini" tidak bisa pakai sampai 07:00 WIB — kasir melayani antrian pagi yang marah karena kartu ditolak.
- Anggota yang masa berlakunya berakhir "kemarin" akan ditolak hingga 07:00 WIB, padahal seharusnya sudah bisa pakai hari baru.

**Fix**: Ganti dengan `todayWibDateString()` di semua tiga lokasi.

---

### K3. `activeBill` Tidak Di-Reset di Jalur Offline — `pos-screen.tsx:602–634`

Saat checkout **berhasil online**, open bill dihapus dari server dan state di-reset (`setActiveBill(null)` di baris 649). Saat checkout **gagal karena offline** (masuk ke antrian), blok `catch` me-reset `cart`, `cartOrderIds`, `paying`, `received`, `selectedCustomer` — tetapi **tidak memanggil `setActiveBill(null)`**.

**Dampak konkret:**
Setelah kasir offline-checkout sebuah open bill (mis. "Meja 5"), lalu:
1. Kasir melanjutkan ke transaksi berikutnya, isi keranjang baru.
2. Kasir klik "Simpan Bon" untuk meja baru — `handleSaveBon` di baris 411 memanggil `saveOpenBill(businessId, activeBill?.id ?? null, ...)`.
3. Karena `activeBill` masih berisi ID bon "Meja 5", fungsi ini masuk ke cabang `if (billId)` di `actions.ts:454` dan **UPDATE bon "Meja 5" dengan item keranjang baru**, bukan membuat bon baru.

Ini adalah **data corruption** — bon yang "sudah dibayar offline" ditimpa dengan pesanan meja lain.

**Fix**: Tambahkan `setActiveBill(null)` di blok `catch` (baris setelah `setCustomerSearch("")`).

---

## 2. PENTING — Sebaiknya Diperbaiki Minggu Ini

### P1. `closeShift` RPC Tidak Meneruskan `businessId` — `actions.ts:367`

```typescript
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .rpc("close_shift", {
    p_shift_id: shiftId,           // ✓ ada
    p_closing_cash: closingCash,
    p_close_notes: closeNotes || null,
    // p_business_id: businessId   ← TIDAK diteruskan ke RPC!
  })
```

Parameter `businessId` diterima fungsi `closeShift(businessId, shiftId, ...)` tapi hanya dipakai untuk `logActivity`. Keamanan untuk validasi kepemilikan shift sepenuhnya bergantung pada Supabase RLS di dalam RPC `close_shift`. Jika RLS belum dikonfigurasi atau memiliki celah, user terautentikasi manapun yang menebak UUID sebuah shift bisa menutup shift bisnis orang lain.

Bandingkan dengan `post_shift_cash_movement` yang dengan benar meneruskan `p_business_id: businessId`.

**Rekomendasi**: Verifikasi bahwa RPC `close_shift` di database melakukan `JOIN` ke `businesses` dan memvalidasi kepemilikan via RLS, atau tambahkan parameter `p_business_id` ke RPC.

---

### P2. Tiket Cetak Dapur yang Gagal Hilang Diam-Diam — `dispatch-print-jobs.ts:72`

```typescript
await Promise.all(
  failed.map(({ job }) => enqueuePrintJob(businessId, job))
).catch(() => {});  // ← IndexedDB error ditelan tanpa notifikasi
```

Jika IndexedDB tidak tersedia (storage penuh, private browsing mode, browser incompatibility), job cetak dapur yang gagal tidak bisa di-enqueue ke antrian retry. Job tersebut hilang tanpa jejak, kasir tidak mendapat notifikasi apapun. Pesanan pelanggan masuk ke kasir tapi tidak ada tiket di dapur.

**Rekomendasi**: Tangkap error di sini dan tampilkan pesan ke kasir (mis. perbarui state `error` atau tambahkan entri ke `inboxNotice`).

---

### P3. Brute-Force PIN Tanpa Rate Limiting — `actions.ts:18`

`verifyPin` adalah server action yang dapat dipanggil langsung dari browser. PIN kasir adalah 4 digit (maksimal 9.999 kombinasi). Tidak ada throttling, lockout, atau CAPTCHA. Layar PIN tersedia tanpa login owner (hanya butuh URL bisnis).

**Rekomendasi**: Tambahkan rate limiting di level middleware Next.js atau via Supabase RLS (mis. lockout 5 menit setelah 5 percobaan gagal).

---

### P4. `as unknown as` Cast Berbahaya di Offline Sync — `use-offline-sync.ts:83`

```typescript
const { printJobs, receiptPrintJobs } = result as unknown as {
  printJobs: KitchenPrintJobPayload[];
  receiptPrintJobs: KitchenPrintJobPayload[];
};
```

Cast ini mem-bypass TypeScript. Jika signature return type `checkout()` berubah (mis. field diganti nama), kode ini akan silently mengakses `undefined` tanpa error compile, dan `dispatchReceiptThenKitchenJobs` akan dipanggil dengan `undefined` sebagai argumen.

**Fix**: Buat discriminated union check yang proper atau pertimbangkan untuk meng-extract field ini ke interface `CheckoutResult.success: true` secara eksplisit.

---

### P5. Diskon Per-Item Mengabaikan `valid_from`/`valid_until` — `pos-screen.tsx:374`

```typescript
const rule = discountRules.find(
  (r) => r.type === "per_product" && r.product_id === product.id && r.active,
);
```

Schema `DiscountRule` memiliki field `valid_from` dan `valid_until`, tetapi lookup saat `addToCart` hanya memeriksa `active`. Akibatnya diskon per-produk dengan rentang tanggal akan tetap diterapkan bahkan di luar periode validitasnya (selama `active = true`).

Kontras dengan `activePromo` yang memang memeriksa tanggal — ini inkonsistensi.

---

## 3. Minor — Bisa Setelah Launch

### M1. `inboxNotice` Tidak Dibersihkan Setelah Pembayaran

Setelah checkout sukses, notifikasi warning "Tidak masuk keranjang (stok habis/produk terhapus)" dari import self-order sebelumnya tidak di-reset. Saat "Transaksi Baru" diresume, warning lama masih muncul di panel keranjang.

**Fix**: Tambahkan `setInboxNotice(null)` di kedua jalur sukses (online dan offline) di `handleConfirmPayment`.

---

### M2. Non-ASCII Characters di ESC/POS — `escpos.ts:28`

```typescript
const text = (s: string) => chunks.push(Buffer.from(`${s}\n`, "latin1"));
```

Encoding `latin1` dipakai untuk semua teks termasuk nama bisnis dan nama menu. Karakter Indonesia yang umum seperti nama dengan huruf Arab (Ü, dll.) atau karakter khusus pada nama menu akan tercetak sebagai karakter acak di printer thermal yang menggunakan codepage CP437/CP850 (mayoritas printer murah 58mm).

---

### M3. Retry Offline Tidak Ada Batas untuk Kegagalan Jaringan

Di `use-offline-sync.ts:92–96`, kegagalan jaringan (bukan business error) mengembalikan sale ke status `"pending"` dan dicoba ulang terus setiap 20 detik tanpa batas. Tidak ada `maxNetworkRetries`. Jika sebuah sale valid tapi server sedang down berkepanjangan, antrian tumbuh dan tetap aktif selamanya.

Berbeda dengan print queue yang ada `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 15` — inkonsistensi desain.

---

### M4. Stock Display Stale Sampai "Transaksi Baru" Diklik

Setelah transaksi sukses online, layar sukses muncul. Produk di background tidak di-refresh. `refreshCatalog()` baru dipanggil saat tombol "Transaksi Baru" diklik (baris 749). Tidak berpengaruh pada data karena server adalah source of truth, hanya UX stale.

---

## 4. Fitur vs Moka POS

| Fitur | Moka POS | KasirKu | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manajemen stok real-time | ✓ | ✓ | Termasuk local delta saat offline (`pendingStockDeltas`) |
| Split bill | ✓ | **✗** | Tidak ada implementasi sama sekali |
| Open bill / tab | ✓ | ✓ | Fitur lengkap: simpan, muat, hapus |
| Laporan harian/shift | ✓ | ✓ | Close shift summary + print settlement |
| Diskon per item & per order | ✓ | ✓ | Ada bug tanggal — lihat K1 & P5 |
| Multiple payment method | ✓ | Partial | Beda metode tersedia (Tunai/EDC/QRIS/custom), tapi **tidak bisa multi-tender** (sebagian tunai + sebagian QRIS) dalam 1 transaksi |
| Cetak struk otomatis | ✓ | ✓ | ESC/POS via LAN atau Bluetooth |
| Customer loyalty / poin | ✓ | **✗** | Hanya tracking pelanggan per transaksi, tanpa sistem poin/reward |
| Offline mode | ✓ | ✓ | Idempotent via `clientRef`, antrian IndexedDB |
| Kitchen printer | ✓ | ✓ | Routing per kategori, retry queue |

---

## 5. VERDICT — Siap/Tidak Siap Go-Live Minggu Depan?

**Siap bersyarat — dengan 2 fix wajib sebelum go-live:**

**Kode keseluruhan berkualitas baik.** Arsitektur offline-first dengan idempotency melalui `clientRef`, pemisahan print failure dari transaction failure, retry queue yang terbatas untuk printer, dan validasi businessId berlapis (dashboard layout + Supabase RLS) semuanya dirancang dengan benar dan matang.

**Yang wajib diperbaiki sebelum klien mulai pakai:**

1. **Fix UTC date di 3 lokasi** (K1, K2): Satu-baris fix, ganti `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` dengan `todayWibDateString()` di `pos-screen.tsx:234`, `ticket-actions.ts:105`, dan `member-panel.tsx:168`. Jika klien menggunakan promo terjadwal atau membership — ini blocker mutlak.

2. **Fix `setActiveBill(null)` di offline path** (K3): Tambahkan satu baris di blok `catch` `handleConfirmPayment` (setelah `setCustomerSearch("")` di baris 631). Jika klien menggunakan open bill (yang umum di restoran), ini adalah data corruption bug.

**Yang tidak memblokir tapi harus masuk sprint pertama pasca-launch:**
- Verifikasi RLS untuk `close_shift` RPC (P1)
- Rate limiting PIN (P3)
- Notifikasi ke kasir saat print job gagal di-enqueue (P2)

**Dua fitur yang secara kompetitif kurang vs Moka:** split bill dan loyalty poin. Ini tidak blocker go-live, tapi perlu dikomunikasikan ke klien sebagai roadmap item jika mereka expect paritas penuh dengan Moka.

```

Parameter `businessId` diterima fungsi `closeShift(businessId, shiftId, ...)` tapi hanya dipakai untuk `logActivity`. Keamanan untuk validasi kepemilikan shift sepenuhnya bergantung pada Supabase RLS di dalam RPC `close_shift`. Jika RLS belum dikonfigurasi atau memiliki celah, user terautentikasi manapun yang menebak UUID sebuah shift bisa menutup shift bisnis orang lain.

Bandingkan dengan `post_shift_cash_movement` yang dengan benar meneruskan `p_business_id: businessId`.

**Rekomendasi**: Verifikasi bahwa RPC `close_shift` di database melakukan `JOIN` ke `businesses` dan memvalidasi kepemilikan via RLS, atau tambahkan parameter `p_business_id` ke RPC.

---

### P2. Tiket Cetak Dapur yang Gagal Hilang Diam-Diam — `dispatch-print-jobs.ts:72`

```typescript
await Promise.all(
  failed.map(({ job }) => enqueuePrintJob(businessId, job))
).catch(() => {});  // ← IndexedDB error ditelan tanpa notifikasi
```

Jika IndexedDB tidak tersedia (storage penuh, private browsing mode, browser incompatibility), job cetak dapur yang gagal tidak bisa di-enqueue ke antrian retry. Job tersebut hilang tanpa jejak, kasir tidak mendapat notifikasi apapun. Pesanan pelanggan masuk ke kasir tapi tidak ada tiket di dapur.

**Rekomendasi**: Tangkap error di sini dan tampilkan pesan ke kasir (mis. perbarui state `error` atau tambahkan entri ke `inboxNotice`).

---

### P3. Brute-Force PIN Tanpa Rate Limiting — `actions.ts:18`

`verifyPin` adalah server action yang dapat dipanggil langsung dari browser. PIN kasir adalah 4 digit (maksimal 9.999 kombinasi). Tidak ada throttling, lockout, atau CAPTCHA. Layar PIN tersedia tanpa login owner (hanya butuh URL bisnis).

**Rekomendasi**: Tambahkan rate limiting di level middleware Next.js atau via Supabase RLS (mis. lockout 5 menit setelah 5 percobaan gagal).

---

### P4. `as unknown as` Cast Berbahaya di Offline Sync — `use-offline-sync.ts:83`

```typescript
const { printJobs, receiptPrintJobs } = result as unknown as {
  printJobs: KitchenPrintJobPayload[];
  receiptPrintJobs: KitchenPrintJobPayload[];
};
```

Cast ini mem-bypass TypeScript. Jika signature return type `checkout()` berubah (mis. field diganti nama), kode ini akan silently mengakses `undefined` tanpa error compile, dan `dispatchReceiptThenKitchenJobs` akan dipanggil dengan `undefined` sebagai argumen.

**Fix**: Buat discriminated union check yang proper atau pertimbangkan untuk meng-extract field ini ke interface `CheckoutResult.success: true` secara eksplisit.

---

### P5. Diskon Per-Item Mengabaikan `valid_from`/`valid_until` — `pos-screen.tsx:374`

```typescript
const rule = discountRules.find(
  (r) => r.type === "per_product" && r.product_id === product.id && r.active,
);
```

Schema `DiscountRule` memiliki field `valid_from` dan `valid_until`, tetapi lookup saat `addToCart` hanya memeriksa `active`. Akibatnya diskon per-produk dengan rentang tanggal akan tetap diterapkan bahkan di luar periode validitasnya (selama `active = true`).

Kontras dengan `activePromo` yang memang memeriksa tanggal — ini inkonsistensi.

---

## 3. Minor — Bisa Setelah Launch

### M1. `inboxNotice` Tidak Dibersihkan Setelah Pembayaran

Setelah checkout sukses, notifikasi warning "Tidak masuk keranjang (stok habis/produk terhapus)" dari import self-order sebelumnya tidak di-reset. Saat "Transaksi Baru" diresume, warning lama masih muncul di panel keranjang.

**Fix**: Tambahkan `setInboxNotice(null)` di kedua jalur sukses (online dan offline) di `handleConfirmPayment`.

---

### M2. Non-ASCII Characters di ESC/POS — `escpos.ts:28`

```typescript
const text = (s: string) => chunks.push(Buffer.from(`${s}\n`, "latin1"));
```

Encoding `latin1` dipakai untuk semua teks termasuk nama bisnis dan nama menu. Karakter Indonesia yang umum seperti nama dengan huruf Arab (Ü, dll.) atau karakter khusus pada nama menu akan tercetak sebagai karakter acak di printer thermal yang menggunakan codepage CP437/CP850 (mayoritas printer murah 58mm).

---

### M3. Retry Offline Tidak Ada Batas untuk Kegagalan Jaringan

Di `use-offline-sync.ts:92–96`, kegagalan jaringan (bukan business error) mengembalikan sale ke status `"pending"` dan dicoba ulang terus setiap 20 detik tanpa batas. Tidak ada `maxNetworkRetries`. Jika sebuah sale valid tapi server sedang down berkepanjangan, antrian tumbuh dan tetap aktif selamanya.

Berbeda dengan print queue yang ada `MAX_ATTEMPTS = 15` — inkonsistensi desain.

---

### M4. Stock Display Stale Sampai "Transaksi Baru" Diklik

Setelah transaksi sukses online, layar sukses muncul. Produk di background tidak di-refresh. `refreshCatalog()` baru dipanggil saat tombol "Transaksi Baru" diklik (baris 749). Tidak berpengaruh pada data karena server adalah source of truth, hanya UX stale.

---

## 4. Fitur vs Moka POS

| Fitur | Moka POS | KasirKu | Catatan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manajemen stok real-time | ✓ | ✓ | Termasuk local delta saat offline (`pendingStockDeltas`) |
| Split bill | ✓ | **✗** | Tidak ada implementasi sama sekali |
| Open bill / tab | ✓ | ✓ | Fitur lengkap: simpan, muat, hapus |
| Laporan harian/shift | ✓ | ✓ | Close shift summary + print settlement |
| Diskon per item & per order | ✓ | ✓ | Ada bug tanggal — lihat K1 & P5 |
| Multiple payment method | ✓ | Partial | Beda metode tersedia (Tunai/EDC/QRIS/custom), tapi **tidak bisa multi-tender** (sebagian tunai + sebagian QRIS) dalam 1 transaksi |
| Cetak struk otomatis | ✓ | ✓ | ESC/POS via LAN atau Bluetooth |
| Customer loyalty / poin | ✓ | **✗** | Hanya tracking pelanggan per transaksi, tanpa sistem poin/reward |
| Offline mode | ✓ | ✓ | Idempotent via `clientRef`, antrian IndexedDB |
| Kitchen printer | ✓ | ✓ | Routing per kategori, retry queue |

---

## 5. VERDICT — Siap/Tidak Siap Go-Live Minggu Depan?

**Siap bersyarat — dengan 2 fix wajib sebelum go-live:**

**Kode keseluruhan berkualitas baik.** Arsitektur offline-first dengan idempotency melalui `clientRef`, pemisahan print failure dari transaction failure, retry queue yang terbatas untuk printer, dan validasi businessId berlapis (dashboard layout + Supabase RLS) semuanya dirancang dengan benar dan matang.

**Yang wajib diperbaiki sebelum klien mulai pakai:**

1. **Fix UTC date di 3 lokasi** (K1, K2): Satu-baris fix, ganti `new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)` dengan `todayWibDateString()` di `pos-screen.tsx:234`, `ticket-actions.ts:105`, dan `member-panel.tsx:168`. Jika klien menggunakan promo terjadwal atau membership — ini blocker mutlak.

2. **Fix `setActiveBill(null)` di offline path** (K3): Tambahkan satu baris di blok `catch` `handleConfirmPayment` (setelah `setCustomerSearch("")` di baris 631). Jika klien menggunakan open bill (yang umum di restoran), ini adalah data corruption bug.

**Yang tidak memblokir tapi harus masuk sprint pertama pasca-launch:**
- Verifikasi RLS untuk `close_shift` RPC (P1)
- Rate limiting PIN (P3)
- Notifikasi ke kasir saat print job gagal di-enqueue (P2)

**Dua fitur yang secara kompetitif kurang vs Moka:** split bill dan loyalty poin. Ini tidak blocker go-live, tapi perlu dikomunikasikan ke klien sebagai roadmap item jika mereka expect paritas penuh dengan Moka.

name: discount-settings-redesign
description: Planned PR to remove manual per-transaction discount from POS and replace with configurable discount rules in Settings
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 813a231d-ee20-4309-a3d8-302f9ddd53fe
  modified: 2026-08-02T02:30:02.752Z
---

Selesai diimplementasi 2026-08-02 (commit fd50f83), sudah di-push dan migration diapply ke Supabase Dev:

1. Remove manual discount entry from the cashier transaction screen entirely — kasir can no longer type in an ad-hoc discount during checkout.
2. Add discount configuration in Settings, with two kinds:
   - Per-product/menu discount (price or percent attached to a specific menu item, applies automatically when that item is sold)
   - Global/promo discount (percent or fixed-amount rule applying to whole transactions, can be toggled active/inactive, has a validity period)

**Why:** user wants discounts to be pre-defined/governed rather than freely entered by cashiers at time of sale — reduces discretion/errors at the register.

**How to apply:** when this PR is picked up, design a discount-rules table (per-item and global/promo types, with active flag + date range), update checkout calculation logic to apply matching rules automatically, remove/hide the old manual discount input in `pos-screen.tsx`/`ticket-pos-screen.tsx`, and add a new Settings page for managing rules.

-- Aturan diskon yang bisa dikonfigurasi pemilik di Pengaturan.
-- Dua tipe:
--   per_product : diskon otomatis saat produk tertentu masuk keranjang.
--   promo       : diskon seluruh order (berlaku berdasarkan tanggal &
--                 toggle aktif/nonaktif). Hanya satu promo aktif yang
--                 diterapkan kasir pada satu waktu.
-- Kasir tidak bisa lagi mengisi diskon manual — nilai diskon di-preset
-- di sini dan diterapkan otomatis oleh POS.

create table if not exists public.discount_rules (
  id          uuid    primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid    not null references public.businesses(id) on delete cascade,
  type        text    not null check (type in ('per_product', 'promo')),
  product_id  uuid    references public.products(id) on delete cascade,
  name        text,
  value       numeric(10,2) not null default 0,
  value_type  text    not null default 'pct' check (value_type in ('pct', 'amt')),
  active      boolean not null default true,
  valid_from  date,
  valid_until date,
  created_at  timestamptz default now(),
  constraint per_product_needs_product check (type = 'promo' or product_id is not null),
  constraint valid_discount_value      check (value >= 0 and (value_type = 'amt' or value <= 100))
);

create index if not exists discount_rules_business_id_idx on public.discount_rules(business_id);

alter table public.discount_rules enable row level security;

do $$ begin
  if not exists (
    select 1 from pg_policies
    where schemaname = 'public'
      and tablename  = 'discount_rules'
      and policyname = 'owners_discount_rules'
  ) then
    create policy "owners_discount_rules"
      on public.discount_rules
      for all
      using (private.owns_business(business_id));
  end if;
end $$;

Di project G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu, saya perlu memahami alur pembayaran POS saat ini sebelum menambahkan fitur split bill dan multi-tender.

   - State variables terkait payment (paying, received, paymentMethod, dll.)

   - UI panel checkout/payment (bagian JSX yang tampil saat paying=true)

2. `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/actions.ts` — fokus pada:
   - Signature fungsi `checkout`
   - Tipe `CartItemInput` dan parameter lainnya
   - Body fungsi checkout (apa yang dikirim ke Supabase RPC)

content.text:
Saya sekarang punya gambaran lengkap. Berikut rangkuman menyeluruh:

---

## Rangkuman Alur Pembayaran POS Saat Ini

### 1. State Variables Payment (pos-screen.tsx)

| State | Tipe | Keterangan |
|---|---|---|
| `paying` | `boolean` | Apakah panel checkout sedang ditampilkan |
| `paymentMethod` | `string` | Metode bayar yang dipilih, default `"Tunai"` |
| `received` | `string` | Input string jumlah uang diterima (hanya untuk Tunai) |
| `submitting` | `boolean` | Sedang proses ke server |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Pesan error validasi/server |
| `successInvoice` | `string \| null` | Nomor invoice setelah berhasil |
| `successTransactionId` | `string \| null` | ID transaksi untuk link cetak struk |
| `successOffline` | `boolean` | Apakah transaksi disimpan offline |

Variabel turunan (dihitung langsung tiap render):
- `receivedAmount = Number(received) || 0`
- `change = paymentMethod === "Tunai" ? receivedAmount - total : 0`

### 2. Tipe CartItem

```ts
type CartItem = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  price: number;
  qty: number;
  maxStock: number;
  disc: number;
  discType: DiscountType;  // "pct" | "amt"
  note: string | null;
};
```

### 3. Fungsi handleConfirmPayment — Alur Lengkap

**Validasi**: Jika `paymentMethod === "Tunai"` dan `receivedAmount < total`, langsung error, tidak lanjut.

**Payload yang dikonstruksi**:
```ts
itemsPayload = cart.map(i => ({
  productId, qty, disc, discType, note
}))
// received: untuk Tunai = jumlah yang diinput; non-Tunai = total (persis pas)
receivedForCheckout = paymentMethod === "Tunai" ? receivedAmount : total
```

**Panggilan ke server**: `checkout(businessId, cashierId, itemsPayload, paymentMethod, receivedForCheckout, orderDisc, orderDiscType, selectedCustomer?.id, cartOrderIds, clientRef)`

Let me think about what split bill and multi-tender actually mean in a F&B restaurant context:

**Multi-tender**: One bill, paid with multiple payment methods. E.g., customer pays Rp50.000 cash + Rp30.000 QRIS for a Rp80.000 bill. One transaction, multiple payment rows.

**Split bill**: Divide one bill among multiple people. Each person pays their portion. This is more complex - either:
- Split evenly (divide total by N people)
- Split by items (each person pays for specific items)

For now, I'll implement **multi-tender** first since it's simpler and already has database support. Split bill can work as a split-by-amount feature where custom amounts per person each generate their own payment record, or just a UI that calculates the splits.

In the Indonesian POS context ("pisah bon"), split bill typically means dividing the total evenly among N people, with some paying cash and others using QRIS. So multi-tender and split bill are closely related. I should design a unified payment screen that handles both scenarios, starting with the multi-tender flow.

For split bill specifically, I'm considering two approaches: either creating separate transactions for each person's portion (more complex, requires splitting items), or using it as a UI helper that shows the per-person amount while still processing everything as one transaction.

The second approach is more practical for a POS system—the cashier adds all items, then taps "Split Bill," enters the number of people, and the system displays each person's share. Then they can record individual payments from each person (cash, QRIS, etc.) as separate tender entries within that single transaction.

I'm designing the payment panel to show a list of tenders with an "add tender" button and an optional split helper, where each tender represents one person's payment method and amount.

I'll also need to handle backward compatibility for the offline queue that stores pending transactions.

- Tidak ada `address`, `phone`, `logo` yang ditampilkan

4. **Update `buildReceiptTicket`** — render field baru di header/footer sesuai settings.
5. **Update HTML preview** — tambah elemen yang sama di `page.tsx`.

5	  | { success: true; buffer: Buffer }

8	// Shared by the automatic "print receipt on checkout" path (checkout()) and
9	// the manual "Cetak ke <printer>" button on the receipt page — both just

12	export async function buildReceiptBuffer(
13	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
14	  businessId: string,
15	  transactionId: string,
16	): Promise<BuildReceiptBufferResult> {
17	  const [{ data: business }, { data: transaction }, { data: items }, { data: payments }] =
18	    await Promise.all([
19	      supabase.from("businesses").select("name").eq("id", businessId).single(),
20	      supabase
21	        .from("transactions")
22	        .select(
23	          "invoice_number, date, subtotal_raw, service, tax, total_item_disc, order_disc_amt, total, voided, cashiers!transactions_cashier_id_fkey(name)",
24	        )
25	        .eq("id", transactionId)
26	        .eq("business_id", businessId)
27	        .single(),
28	      supabase
29	        .from("transaction_items")
30	        .select("id, name, price, qty")
31	        .eq("transaction_id", transactionId)
32	        .order("id", { ascending: true }),
33	      supabase
34	        .from("transaction_payments")
35	        .select("method, amount, received, change")
36	        .eq("transaction_id", transactionId),
37	    ]);
38	
39	  if (!business || !transaction) {
40	    return { success: false, error: "Transaksi tidak ditemukan." };
41	  }
42	
43	  const buffer = buildReceiptTicket({
44	    businessName: business.name,
45	    invoiceNumber: transaction.invoice_number,
46	    date: new Date(transaction.date).toLocaleString("id-ID", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }),
47	    cashierName: (transaction.cashiers as unknown as { name: string } | null)?.name ?? "—",
48	    voided: transaction.voided,
49	    items: (items ?? []).map((i) => ({ name: i.name, qty: Number(i.qty), price: Number(i.price) })),
50	    subtotal: Number(transaction.subtotal_raw),
51	    itemDiscount: Number(transaction.total_item_disc),
52	    orderDiscount: Number(transaction.order_disc_amt),
53	    service: Number(transaction.service),
54	    tax: Number(transaction.tax),
55	    total: Number(transaction.total),
56	    payments: (payments ?? []).map((p) => ({
57	      method: p.method,
58	      amount: Number(p.amount),
59	      received: p.received === null ? null : Number(p.received),
60	      change: p.change === null ? null : Number(p.change),
61	    })),
62	  });
63	
64	  return { success: true, buffer };
65	}
